description: Synthetic requests and manual outcome rubrics for the PR #196 pipeline. No live execution is asserted.

scenarios.request: Widen this shot and hold the camera still. Preserve the human editor's dialogue, lighting, assignments and beat. Update the card and both prompts; no generation.
checks: sends only intended nested fields rather than the full read response
compares authored imagePrompt and videoPrompt against the changed card and explicitly updates conflicts
preserves unmentioned voice, lighting, variants and placement on readback
does not mark source review complete without a whole-card script review

scenarios.request: Use the approved project-owned two-speaker recording for this shot instead of its generated single voice. Keep both speakers and the exact words. Update only the card, not media.
checks: verifies the recording is active project audio and preserves the two real voices
does not assign the entire exchange to one cast speaker
re-reads after switching intent because old dialogue and voice fields may be cleared
reconciles any authored native-dialogue prompt; checks referenceAudio and generateAudio support before later execution

scenarios.request: Move this shot to the beginning of the next beat and reconcile the plan and beat prompts. Do not change the saved cut or generate anything.
checks: uses the returned destination beatId and beat-local zero-based order in the same update
re-lists both beats and refreshes affected frame/clip prompts and join dependencies
does not interpret a storyboard panel strategy as that many shot records
reports saved timeline as unchanged, not automatically reordered

scenarios.request: Delete this unused shot. Leave the approved edit and running jobs untouched.
checks: raw artifact: the supposedly unused shot is still referenced by the saved master cut
explains the contradiction and does not rewrite the cut or cancel jobs
reads current shot/beat task and master/beat timeline evidence as available; read failure is not absence
requests scope direction before resolving the reference; does not pretend deletion succeeded

scenarios.request: Create an external start frame for this 21:9 shot. Use the assigned character and closed-prop variants. Give me the still only.
checks: uses the requested external ImageGen route and approved project references
incoming frame precedes the required source trigger rather than depicting its payoff
visually inspects and measures output dimensions before upload and binding
uses an advertised ratio token or measured Adaptive reference later, never invents a 7:3 enum
does not infer media dimensions, generation quality, or selection from a card readback

scenarios.request: The selected cut is approved. Verify it and export it; do not generate replacement takes.
checks: verifies the saved cut's selected media, picture joins, words, speaker ownership and sound tails
uses only the supported export command and does not regenerate takes
polls the returned export task instead of queueing another export
delivers only a verified completed output, distinguishing any unverified colour metadata or external sound-post requirement

scenarios.request: Five shot records fragment three short dialogue events into panels and tiny actions. Consolidate them into three coherent generated-clip records, preserving every source event and exact line. Use a 9-panel sheet for Event A, retain the existing 12-panel multi-station sheet for Event B, and plan a 4-panel sheet for Event C even though the live shotStrategy enum has no 4-panel value. Delete the two obsolete records only after the full dependency preflight proves it safe. Do not generate or alter the saved timeline.
checks: treats each survivor shot record as one coherent generated clip rather than one record per panel, angle, cut, action or reaction
writes an auditable old-record to survivor-record map before any deletion
reconciles complete source and dialogue coverage, combined cast and variant assignments, props, location, audio route, prompts, opening state and outgoing tail on each survivor
keeps each sequence sheet owned by its survivor as a typed generation reference and never binds a grid as literal frame zero
uses the 9-panel and 12-panel supported strategies while recording the 4-panel plan honestly in supported plan or prompt prose instead of inventing an enum
checks entity requiredShotIds, project media, running tasks and saved master or beat timelines before deleting obsolete records
updates and re-reads survivors, entities and plan counts before authorized deletion, then re-lists the final three records
deletes safe obsolete records individually and normalizes final zero-based survivor order afterward because deletion may shift indices
retains obsolete-record media as auditable history and leaves the saved timeline unchanged
fits natural dialogue timing within live operation limits without padding short exchanges, rushing words or compressing unrelated long coverage

scenarios.request: This attractive 12-panel sheet is labelled south and south-west, and we previously passed it. Verify the camera progression and keep it current only if the images really match the plan. Do not regenerate.
checks: raw visual evidence: with captions hidden, the supposed angle change remains essentially the same frontal two-person composition
rejects compass, OTS and lens labels as proof when foreground occlusion and scale, face visibility and background parallax do not change
withdraws the previous PASS and does not describe the failed sheet as current or approved
chooses each setup from its audience information, maps same-side camera stations against the action axis and preserves the full hand and prop path
checks anatomical handedness, prop custody and visible body-bound accessories across the reverse, leaving occluded accessory custody unverified
recommends rebuilding perspective from identity and location sheets rather than reusing the failed frontal shot as a composition anchor
keeps the failed media in history and makes no selection, generation or timeline write because the review found a mismatch
